app_fee.value: The application fee is $75 USD, non-refundable and paid by card in the online application.
app_fee.quote: Our application fee is $75. The fee is non-refundable, and can be paid by credit card as part of the online application.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants can get the financial-hardship fee waiver, but only a limited number are offered.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not set one GRE rule; each program decides whether the GRE General is needed.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School gives no TOEFL minimum; each program sets its own TOEFL requirement.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School gives no IELTS minimum; many programs accept IELTS, but no score is set.

english_waiver.value: The Graduate School's English rules do not mention India or English-medium degrees.
